provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

nameChecks.ja: 黒雲会副組長 ジュン

gameLocalization.note: Names follow the paired Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones event records. The guide spelling 黒雲道 maps to 黒雲刀 / Kokuuntō, verified against passive 9101301 and its Slash Skill Final Power +1 effect. Lenticular Slash, Sharp Edge, Brutal Stab, Draw of the Sword, and Slay use the enemy records rather than same-named Identity skills. Normal story and dungeon variants, Shield amounts, Minus Coins, and temporary action-slot conditions are retained.

stageName.text: Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones: Black Clouds

lead.text: More surviving adds mean more Coins on his ordinary Counter. Protect the first Sinner to trigger it, clear the adds, then finish him after the 30% HP Stagger. “Sky-clearing Cut” retains its Combat Start buffs even after he is isolated; save strong clash skills.

listLead.text: More surviving adds mean more Coins on the ordinary Counter. Check the first attacker's resistances and HP, clear adds, then Stagger and finish. Prepare for the major attack after the boss is isolated.

statNote.text: The Normal 5.5-22 boss: Level 40, 359 HP, and Defense Level 40. Slash multiplier 1.2, Pierce 0.5, Blunt neutral; all Sin resistances neutral. Hard, BokGak, and enhanced Mirror variants are excluded. Check the actual add types and numbers in combat. This is a regular encounter; do not assume the free targeting available in focused encounters.

skillNote.text: All 6 boss skills. “Rules of the Backstreets” adds up to 3 Coins to its base 1 according to surviving allies; displayed values are before additions. Base ranges also exclude “Sky-clearing Cut”'s and “Sharp Edge”'s Combat Start buffs and Kokuuntō's constant +1.

priorities.0.text: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher on the main team. Bring Slash damage and Slash resistance for whoever takes the ordinary Counter.

priorities.1.text: With many surviving adds, the Counter reaches 4 Coins. Clear adds and avoid leaving the first Sinner attacking the boss at low HP.

priorities.2.text: Aim for the 30% HP (108) Stagger. Save a powerful skill for “Sky-clearing Cut” before Stagger, accounting for Combat Start buffs too.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The Counter suddenly kills a main attacker

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: “Rules of the Backstreets” is an ordinary Counter reaching 4 Coins based on other living allies. Defense skills cannot Offset it. Remove adds or prepare resistance and HP for the first attacker.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: “Sky-clearing Cut” wins despite a favorable prediction

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: The +5 Final Power on turns with 5 attack skills and “Sharp Edge”'s +2 Slash Power activate at Combat Start. Kokuuntō adds another +1; its base maximum of 22 alone does not guarantee a win.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The boss gained actions after an add died

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Clean Up adds at most 1 slot on the turn after an ally dies; that increase does not persist into the following turn. Save strong skills for the extra-action turn and exploit the reduced Counter Coins too.

units.0.notes.0.text: The extra slot on ally death activates once per turn, only for next turn, up to 5 slots. It is not a permanent increase.

units.0.notes.1.text: The ordinary Counter reaches 4 Coins based on surviving allies. Fewer adds mean fewer added Coins.

units.0.notes.2.text: No Stagger until 30% HP. Prepare for Counters and finishers while his remaining HP is still high.

phases.0.title.text: Limit Counter Coins and check attack order

phases.0.steps.0.text: Remove adds to reduce “Rules of the Backstreets”' added Coins. Avoid lining up unnecessary one-sided attacks on the boss; check Slash/Envy resistance and HP on the first Sinner whose attack reaches him.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Taking Bleed enables enemy Coin Power and damage bonuses. Take winning clashes and prevent stacked Slash Fragility or Paralyze too.

phases.0.steps.2.text: An add's death grants the boss 1 extra action next turn. Even multiple deaths trigger this only once per turn; previous increases do not permanently accumulate.

phases.1.title.text: Account for Combat Start buffs when stopping it

phases.1.steps.0.text: The normal pattern uses “Sky-clearing Cut” on turn 3. Its base maximum of 22 gains Kokuuntō, “Sharp Edge”, and +5 on turns with 5 attack skills; retain powerful E.G.O or equivalent skills.

phases.1.steps.1.text: At 10+ Bleed on the target, Attack Weight +1; at 7+ Bleed, damage also increases. Keep it off high-Bleed damage dealers.

phases.1.steps.2.text: “Sharp Edge”'s buffs activate at Combat Start. Winning its clash does not remove buffs from the other attacks that turn.

phases.2.steps.0.text: Use Slash to reach the 108-HP Stagger and commit strong attacks while Staggered. Avoid relying heavily on Pierce against its halved damage.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Even without adds, the base 1-Coin Counter and “Sky-clearing Cut” remain. Keep checking resistance, Bleed, and clashes to the end.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Heavy Bleed costs HP whenever Coins are tossed. Do not force every extra action into attacks; use defense or healing too.

skills.0.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has 5+ Bleed, damage +10%

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1

skills.0.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1

skills.0.response.text: Adds both Bleed Potency and Count. At 5+ Bleed, gains +10% damage on use; take winning clashes before repeated hits accumulate.

skills.1.effects.0.text: If the target has 5+ Bleed, Coin Power +1

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Slash Fragility next turn

skills.1.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Slash Fragility next turn

skills.1.response.text: Gains +1 Coin Power against targets with 5+ Bleed. Hits also inflict next-turn Slash Fragility; prevent it from reaching whoever will take the next Counter.

skills.2.effects.0.text: If the target has 5+ Bleed, Coin Power +1

skills.2.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn

skills.2.response.text: At 5+ Bleed, +1 Coin Power strengthens it beyond the base range. Prevent next-turn Paralyze and added Bleed Count to preserve your main clash winners.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Grant all allies, including self, 2 Slash Damage Up

skills.3.response.text: The team's 2 Slash Damage Up and the user's 2 Slash Power Up activate at Combat Start. Winning does not prevent these buffs, which also affect other Slash attacks.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] If the main target has 10+ Bleed, Attack Weight +1

skills.4.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] If using 5 attack skills this turn, Final Power +5

skills.4.effects.2.text: [On Clash Win] All allies heal 10 SP

skills.4.effects.3.text: If the target has 7+ Bleed, damage +30%

skills.4.effects.6.text: ⅢIf the target has 7+ Bleed, damage +50%

skills.4.response.text: Beyond its base maximum of 22, gains +5 Final Power at Combat Start on turns with 5 attacks. Check “Sharp Edge” and Kokuuntō too, rather than assigning solely from the win prediction. At 10+ Bleed, Attack Weight also increases.

skills.5.effects.0.text: [On Use] Add 1 Coin per surviving ally other than self (max 3)

skills.5.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.5.response.text: An ordinary Counter adding up to 3 Coins based on other living allies. Defense cannot Offset its maximum 4-Coin retaliation; check Slash/Envy resistance and HP on the first attacker.

passives.0.condition.text: On Hit / at most 3 times per turn

passives.0.response.text: Adds Bleed beyond skill effects; prevent hits themselves.

passives.1.response.text: Stop it through clashes before Bleed bonuses activate.

passives.2.response.text: Do not judge solely from the base Power range.

passives.3.effect.text: Gain 1 action slot next turn, up to 5 slots. The increase does not persist across turns.

passives.3.response.text: Prepare for the additional action next turn. Do not treat slots as permanently accumulating.

mechanics.0.effect.text: “Rules of the Backstreets” adds a Coin per other living ally to its base 1 Coin, up to 3 added Coins.

mechanics.0.response.text: Clear adds to limit damage to the first attacker.

mechanics.1.effect.text: “Sharp Edge” gives self 2 Slash Power Up. “Sky-clearing Cut” gains +5 Final Power on turns with 5 attack skills.

mechanics.1.response.text: Retain powerful skills accounting for these buffs rather than relying only on the win prediction.

warnings.0.text: Defense skills cannot Offset ordinary Counters.

warnings.1.text: “Sky-clearing Cut” retains its Combat Start buffs after the adds are gone.

warnings.2.text: This page focuses on the boss's skills and passives. Also check add positions, Bleed, and targets in combat.

warnings.3.text: Hard and Mirror variants have different buffs. This page covers the Normal story encounter.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher on the main team. Prepare Slash resistance, HP recovery, and powerful clash skills.

preparation.1.text: Slash works well against the boss. Secure resources for powerful E.G.O before “Sky-clearing Cut”.

preparation.2.text: Keep high-Bleed Sinners from taking the Counter and check how many Coins they will toss.

roles.0.reason.text: Reduce added Counter Coins and prepare for next turn's extra action.

roles.1.reason.text: Stagger the boss and finish him during Stagger.

roles.2.reason.text: Prepare resistance and HP for the first attacker.
